preconditions.description: The length of the string s must be between 1 and 1000.
The integer k must be between 1 and 1000.
The length of the string s must be divisible by k.

postconditions.description: If the string s can be split into k palindromic substrings of equal length, the output must be 'YES'.
If the string s cannot be split into k palindromic substrings of equal length, the output must be 'NO'.

raw_response: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"1 <= len(s) <= 1000","description":"The length of the string s must be between 1 and 1000."},{"id":"P2","expression":"1 <= k <= 1000","description":"The integer k must be between 1 and 1000."},{"id":"P3","expression":"len(s) % k == 0","description":"The length of the string s must be divisible by k."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"stdout == 'YES'","description":"If the string s can be split into k palindromic substrings of equal length, the output must be 'YES'."},{"id":"Q2","expression":"stdout == 'NO'","description":"If the string s cannot be split into k palindromic substrings of equal length, the output must be 'NO'."}],"invariants":[]}
